_note: Playstyle for the Storm energy deck: the whole game is a race to aspect 3, whose power is a free Art that draws two cards every Combat. The Grimoire rules out the Ascension win and shields Fervor, so Fervor is only fuel for the climb: two-Fervor Arts, Transformation and Mutual Escalation all go toward it, and the opponent must not be handed their own top aspect on the way. Arts cost Energy, so Energy is worth keeping. The Automaton search package and the searching blocks are the card engine: blocks that replace themselves are cheap to spend. The win itself is wounds from Arts.
name: storm_volley
